metadata.source: College Scorecard Most-Recent-Cohorts institution and Field of Study files for all 16 Title IV schools; DC DOES, Maryland Dept. of Labor and sponsor sites for the 4 apprenticeship sponsors.
metadata.geographic_scope: District of Columbia, Maryland and Virginia only
metadata.revision_notes: Scoped to DC/MD/VA. Removed 12 out-of-region institutions (archived in institutions_removed_out_of_scope.json). Added NOVA, Prince George's CC, CCBC, UDC (incl. UDC-CC), George Mason, William & Mary, Towson, Howard and 4 RAPIDS apprenticeship sponsors (20 total). Added fields: record_id, provider_type, apprenticeship, data_status, notes. Nulls mean 'not yet loaded', not zero. v1.1.0 (2026-11-21): corrected source metadata; added provenance, data_quality_flags, programs (null), income tiers 4-5 (null), cohort_default_rate_cohort_fy and cohort_default_rate_display; fixed 3 OPE IDs; consistent key order. v1.2.0 (2026-11-21): all Title IV metrics reloaded from the Scorecard institution file, replacing IPEDS/DataUSA/third-party values; income tiers 4-5 loaded; programs loaded from the Field of Study file. v1.3.0 (2026-11-21): Linked Computer Science (CIP 11.07) programs to 15-1252 Software Developers, per the NCES CIP2020-SOC2018 crosswalk, and recomputed its national debt/earnings from the Field of Study file (debt $20,743 -> $20,500; 1-yr earnings $66,691 -> $69,615; 429/482 -> 784/861 programs). dmv_providers now lists only providers with at least one completer in the last two years (completers_2yr > 0) at the required credential level. Programs with null completer counts moved to new field dmv_providers_unconfirmed. Apprenticeship sponsors kept. Checked every DC/MD/VA wage row (83 rows) against BLS OEWS May 2025 state file: all match. Replaced the 19-3033 VA 'recheck' flag; added small-sample notes for DC 90th percentiles of 19-3033 and 29-1131. Apprenticeship records now carry the same fields as Title IV records (missing ones set to null), so one schema fits all 20 providers. Apprenticeships: SMART Local 100 ZIP 20746 (4725 Silver Hill Rd, Suitland) and VA added (Richmond and Norfolk training centers); Steamfitters 602 length set to 5 years; Mid-Atlantic Carpenters length set to 4 years and DC added (DC DOES list); a source_url added for all four sponsors. Scorecard data_vintage now names the data release (updated June 10, 2026) instead of the upload date.
